capabilities: check grammar and spelling in notes in real time
highlight errors automatically as you type
run the checking engine fully offline on-device
ignore code fences and inline code blocks
support English with an extensible language system
extras: The plugin's code lives in the main Harper monorepo; this repository only satisfies Obsidian plugin requirements. The README warns that an up-to-date Obsidian installer is required and to reinstall Obsidian if issues occur.
intentEvidence: Other systems, like LanguageTool, ship your writing over the internet to centralized servers
motivation: The author built it so grammar checking stays private: "Your Obsidian vault should be just what you expect: locked down and private."
problem: Obsidian has no built-in grammar checking, and existing checkers like LanguageTool send your writing over the internet to centralized servers or need self-hosting.

relations.evidence: Other systems, like LanguageTool, ship your writing over the internet
Unlike other offerings (like Grammarly) Harper also explicitly ignores the contents of code fences

summary: Grammar and spell checker that runs entirely on-device in Obsidian, highlighting errors as you type without sending text to remote servers.
